"""CSV export utilities."""

_QUOTABLE = (",", '"', "\r", "\n")


def _quote_field(value):
    text = "" if value is None else str(value)
    if any(ch in text for ch in _QUOTABLE):
        return '"' + text.replace('"', '""') + '"'
    return text
